text:
The fix is not confirmed on staging. The image `api:7f3c2e1` built, pushed, and rolled out, but `/healthz` returned 503 for the full 60s healthcheck window, so the new pods aren't reporting healthy.

I haven't looked into why yet. A 503 could mean the pods are still starting (60s may be too short if startup is slow), a failing readiness dependency, or the fix itself breaking startup. Next step is checking the rollout status and pod logs (`kubectl rollout status deployment/api` and `kubectl logs deployment/api` in the staging namespace) to tell which. I haven't rolled back, so staging is currently running the new image in whatever state it's in.
